explication: Project Quiver is an open-source quadcopter platform; the sampled Python package is its build123d CAD assembly and BOM tooling, not flight-control software. The documented workflow is to assemble STEP-based mechanical and electronics subassemblies into a drone model; BOM data can also be parsed and rendered. The tree and excerpts support the major subsystem boundaries, but the top-level assembly and several subsystem implementations were not sampled, so detailed call wiring is omitted.
